Welcome to Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair

A locally owned community pharmacy on the ground floor of Pacific Fair Shopping Centre in Broadbeach. Whether you’re filling a script, getting a flu shot on your lunch break, or looking for skincare that suits the Gold Coast climate, our pharmacists and beauty advisors take the time to get it right for you.

About us

Why locals choose us

  • Pharmacists who make time for you – ask us anything, no appointment needed.
  • Fast, accurate dispensing with our robotic dispensary. Send your script ahead.
  • GPs in store at Help Medical, a bulk-billing clinic for eligible patients.
  • Walk-in vaccinations, with free government-funded vaccines for eligible people and no service fee.
  • Beauty advice you can trust for skincare, makeup and fragrance.
  • Delivered to your door anywhere on the Gold Coast through Uber Eats.
  • Open 7 days, and until 9pm on Thursdays.

Visit us in store today

Shop 81, Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Hooker Blvd, Broadbeach QLD 4218. Ground floor, north-eastern side of the centre, Next to Proud Smile, near the outdoor entrance from the river.

Our services

Most services need no appointment, so just walk in. For the full list, see pharmacy services.

  • Vaccinations Flu, COVID-19, whooping cough, shingles, RSV, pneumococcal and travel vaccines. Walk in or book. Learn more
  • Doctor's appointment An independent bulk-billing GP clinic inside our store, with QML pathology collection. Walk-ins welcome. Book now
  • Medication packing Your medicines sorted by day and time in weekly blister packs. Learn more
  • Health Station Free blood pressure, weight, BMI and type 2 diabetes risk checks. Learn more
  • Diabetes & NDSS NDSS access point for subsidised diabetes supplies, with pharmacist advice. Learn more
  • Medication reviews A free one-on-one check of all your medicines with a pharmacist. Learn more
  • Skincare & cosmetics Free advice from trained beauty advisors, and brands that suit the Gold Coast climate. Learn more
  • Priceline app Order scripts ahead, get reminders and manage your Sister Club rewards. Learn more

See a GP without leaving the store

Help Medical, an independent general practice located inside our store, offers bulk billing for eligible patients and welcomes walk-ins. See a doctor, then have your script filled a few steps away. A QML Pathology collection room operates inside Help Medical on weekday mornings.

Book a GP About Help Medical

Skincare, makeup and fragrance, with real advice

Our trained beauty advisors help you find products that suit your skin and the Gold Coast climate: strong sun, humidity, salt water and air-conditioning. No booking, no charge. Shop in store, or order for Click & Collect and Uber Eats delivery.

Skincare & self-tan Makeup & fragrance

Quick answers

Where is Priceline Pharmacy inside Pacific Fair?

Ground floor, north-eastern side of the centre, Shop 81, next to Proud Smile and near the outdoor entrance from the river. The prescription counter is at the back of the store on the left. Directions and parking.

Are you open on Sundays?

Yes. We’re open 7 days a week, and until 9pm on Thursdays. See our full opening hours, and check our Google listing for public holidays.

Do I need an appointment for a vaccination?

No. Walk-ins are welcome every day we’re open. You can also book a time online.

Is there a doctor inside the pharmacy?

Yes. Help Medical, an independent bulk-billing GP clinic, is located inside our store. Walk-ins are welcome, or book ahead.

Can I send my prescription before I arrive?

Yes. Send your eScript through the Priceline Pharmacy app or MedAdvisor and choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair. How it works.

More in our frequently asked questions.

Have a question?

Call us on (07) 5592 2099, or email info@pricelinepf.com.au. For prescription and medicine questions, pharmacy@pricelinepf.com.au.
